findings.description: The KMS key encrypting the logs bucket omits enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the key material is never automatically rotated and remains in use indefinitely. This extends the exposure window if the key material is ever compromised and breaches common cryptographic key-management requirements.

No policy argument is defined, so AWS applies the default key policy granting the account root full kms:* access, which delegates key usage and administration to any IAM principal in the account that has matching IAM permissions. For a key protecting log data this weakens least privilege and provides no separation between key administrators and log consumers.
